General situation: In the last 30 days, South American corn and soybeans prices remain elevated, with Brazilian corn FOB Santos at 112.7 USD/ton and soybeans at 662.9 USD/ton. Argentine barley and rice prices are stable but dated, reflecting limited recent market activity. US spot prices for corn, soybeans, and wheat hover around 394.5 USD/ton as of early February 2026, showing no recent updates. What changed vs previous comparable period: No new temporal metrics or direct price changes are available for the last 30 days, indicating a stable or inactive market phase. However, broker desk activity shows fresh offers for corn CIF at 241 EUR/ton for April shipments and bids for sunflower at 301 USD/ton in early March, suggesting some renewed trade interest. Actionable implications for trading/brokerage: Traders should monitor the corn CIF offers from Tarragona and sunflower bids in Marmara for short-term arbitrage opportunities. The rapeseed DAP trades at 500 EUR/ton for August delivery in Herzlake indicate firm pricing in European rapeseed, which may influence oilseed spreads. 

Key facts:
- Brazilian corn FOB Santos at 112.7 USD/ton (March 12, 2026)
- Brazilian soybeans and wheat both at 662.9 USD/ton (March 14, 2026)
- Argentine barley Grade 2 Up River at 212 USD/ton (December 31, 2025)
- US spot corn, soybeans, and wheat at 394.5 USD/ton (February 4, 2026)
- Broker offer: Corn CIF at 241 EUR/ton for April 10-30 shipment from Tarragona (March 25, 2026)
- Broker bid: Sunflower CPT at 301 USD/ton for early March in Marmara (March 24, 2026)
- Rapeseed DAP trades at 500 EUR/ton for August 2026 delivery in Herzlake (March 30, 2026)

Ціна соняшнику на паритеті Одеса становить 709 USD/т, а сої – 448 USD/т, що також не демонструє різких коливань. Ріпак на паритеті Одеса зберігає ціну близько 593 USD/т, що відповідає стабільному попиту на переробку.
